entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗与阿曼商议霍尔木兹海峡临时航运走廊
美联社8月25日报道，两国外长讨论分阶段恢复船舶通行、建立临时航运走廊并协作清雷；但一艘油轮在阿曼外海遇袭，说明能源安全风险仍未解除。事实是外交窗口重开，判断上有利于压低油价风险溢价，失效条件是航运再受袭或谈判破裂。
国际
美国扩大对伊朗制裁，德黑兰警告将反制
美国进一步收紧对伊朗经济与能源网络的制裁，伊朗称不会屈服并警告支持制裁者。冲突与谈判并行使油价、航运和通胀预期保持高波动；亚洲市场需同时观察布油和长端美债。
科技
完整行业榜显示铀与金属链领涨，专业零售和化学制品居末
Moomoo完整读取5页145个行业：铀+4.82%、医药零售+3.17%、铝+2.70%、白银+2.69%、铜+2.64%居前；糖果-2.21%、服装制造-2.38%、鞋类及配饰-2.72%、化学制品-3.00%、专业零售-4.25%居末。黄金与其他贵金属均+2.18%，对A/H金铜稀土形成正映射。
科技
Sparks加密与稀土概念走强，锂电池与锂矿承压
Sparks一次完整加载118张概念卡并取得109个完整结构化概念：加密矿企+6.26%、加密货币+5.51%、稀土+4.69%居前，GLXY +8.54%、EXOD +23.44%、CRML +21.44%；锂电池-2.54%、体育-2.86%、锂矿-3.99%居末。A/H开盘重点验证稀土资源能否放量、锂链是否继续弱于新能源大盘。
科技
半导体与存储现金时段走强，但夜盘科技代理回落
行业榜半导体+1.85%，MRAM +9.23%；Sparks存储概念+2.41%，WDC现金时段+3.53%。但08:28 CST夜盘QQQ -0.270%、WDC -0.829%，构成强势收盘后的背离；A/H芯片和存储只在集合竞价强于指数且成交放大时视为确认。
科技
英伟达今晚发布财报，AI链面临高波动验证
英伟达官方确认将于8月26日美股收盘后约16:20 ET公布FY2027二季度结果，17:00 ET举行电话会。NVDA现金时段+2.19%、夜盘+0.122%；A/H光模块、服务器和先进封装在财报前更适合等待量价确认，指引不及高预期将放大回撤。
财报
药明生物收入与EBIT高于预期，开盘反馈待验证
Futu财报日历显示上半年收入117.87亿元，高于预期114.73亿元约2.7%；EBIT 38.35亿元，高于预期32.31亿元约18.7%。结果于港股收市后披露，盘前尚无可验证股价反应；若竞价高开并守住量价，生物医药与CXO映射才成立。
财报
农夫山泉收入略超预期，利润保持双位数增长
Futu显示上半年收入297.18亿元，高于预期294.56亿元约0.9%；公开业绩资料显示归母利润88.87亿元、同比增长16.6%。结果在收市后披露，港股价格反馈待开盘；消费防御逻辑需以高开后承接验证。
财报
长城汽车收入超预期但EBIT略低，盈利质量仍需观察
Futu显示二季度收入569.92亿元，高于预期550.88亿元约3.5%；EBIT 20.16亿元，略低于预期20.32亿元约0.8%。港股尚未开市，不能把营收超预期直接等同于股价利好；毛利率、产品结构与竞价表现是首要验证项。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
三只指数ETF代理小幅转弱
Futu OpenD于08:28 CST显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）-0.270%、SPY（标普500代理）-0.125%、DIA（道指代理）-0.011%。均为有成交的实时夜盘ETF代理而非指数期货；行情时间为08/25美东夜盘，抓取与更新时间同在30分钟内。
板块对照
行业与概念代表股同时出现确认、背离和潜在反转
行业Top5代表：EU无成交、HITI无成交、AA -0.585%背离、HSLV无成交、IE +1.595%确认；行业Bottom5：SOWG无成交、XELB无成交、FWDI 0.000%背离、GURE无成交、ABLV无成交。概念Top5：GLXY -0.322%背离、EXOD 0.000%背离、CRML +1.604%确认，GAME两项均无成交；概念Bottom5：EQT +0.314%、SLI +0.778%对页岩油及锂链弱势构成潜在反转，RGR与GIL无成交。结论以有成交项为准，不默认现金方向延续。
A/H映射
资源映射强于指数，芯片和锂链等待竞价确认
金银铜行业现金时段广度强，IE夜盘继续上涨，利多A/H金铜资源；但GLD夜盘-0.425%、QQQ转负，贵金属和高估值科技不宜追高。锂链虽有SLI夜盘+0.778%的反向信号，但只有锂矿、锂电集合竞价同时强于指数才算反转；若资源股高开低走或QQQ跌幅扩大，映射失效。

盘前结论

事实：隔夜美股现金时段风险偏好回升，标普500、道指和纳指分别上涨约0.32%、0.30%和0.66%，金银铜、半导体、存储与稀土主题走强。运行时夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA全部转负，且GLD、WDC回落，说明强势方向出现获利了结。

判断：A/H开盘优先观察金铜稀土与药明生物的独立催化，芯片链只做竞价强于指数后的条件式跟随。锂链虽有代表股夜盘反弹，但现金概念榜仍居末，短线采用“弱势未解除、等待反转确认”的信号。

不确定性：英伟达财报、伊朗制裁与霍尔木兹航运谈判可能在同一天改变科技估值和能源风险溢价；若北向/南向成交不足或恒生科技低开扩大，减少追涨。

重点个股推荐

紫金矿业
02899.HK / 601899.SH
金铜共振

推荐理由：黄金、白银和铜行业同步走强，公司具备金铜双重映射。

触发因素：竞价高于昨收且金铜板块成交额同步放大。

风险点：GLD夜盘下跌0.425%，若高开低走则现金时段利多已被透支。

华虹半导体
01347.HK
芯片映射

推荐理由：美股半导体行业上涨1.85%，存储与CPU主题亦居前。

触发因素：竞价强于恒生科技且中芯国际同步走强。

风险点：QQQ和WDC夜盘转负，英伟达财报前估值波动可能放大。

药明生物
02269.HK
业绩超预期

推荐理由：收入高于预期约2.7%，EBIT高于预期约18.7%。

触发因素：高开后守住首半小时均价，CXO同业同步跟涨。

风险点：盘前尚无价格反馈，若高开低走则业绩利好已被计价。

北方稀土
600111.SH
稀土映射

推荐理由：Sparks稀土概念上涨4.69%，CRML现金时段涨21.44%、夜盘再涨1.604%。

触发因素：稀土永磁板块竞价涨幅居前且量比放大。

风险点：海外代表股波动剧烈，若板块冲高回落应避免追价。

板块轮动看板

受益方向金、银、铜、稀土、CXO；现金时段行业广度与本地业绩共同支持。
观察方向半导体、存储、AI服务器；夜盘背离且英伟达财报临近。
压力方向锂电池、锂矿、油气与部分可选消费；概念榜与油价代理均偏弱。
验证信号竞价相对指数强弱、首30分钟成交、QQQ与GLD夜盘方向、资源高开承接。

逻辑链

美股金银铜、稀土与半导体现金时段走强，为A/H资源和科技提供正映射。
运行时QQQ、GLD与WDC转弱，说明科技和贵金属都存在获利回吐。
A/H开盘先看紫金、北方稀土、华虹与药明生物能否以成交确认独立催化。
若强势板块高开低走或恒生科技跌幅扩大，则转向防御消费并等待英伟达财报。

风险雷达

英伟达财报风险

高预期下收入或指引稍弱都可能冲击AI算力链。

中东再升级

制裁、反制或海峡遇袭会迅速抬升油价与通胀预期。

贵金属夜盘背离

行业现金时段强，但GLD夜盘转跌，追高需谨慎。

锂链弱势未解除

代表股夜盘反弹不等于板块趋势反转。

财报价格反馈缺失

A/H尚未开市，药明、农夫与长城汽车需用竞价验证。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（08:18—08:23 CST，页面时间08/25 20:20 ET；完整5页145行业，黄金/贵金属/白银/铜/半导体重点检查）；Moomoo/Futunn Sparks备用页与Futu同口径结构化数据（08:24—08:25 CST，一次加载118卡、109个完整概念，未重复抓取概念页）；Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ财报日历与NOTICE搜索（08:17 CST）；Futu OpenD QQQ/SPY/DIA、行业与概念代表股夜盘字段（08:27—08:28 CST，ETF代理非指数期货，无成交逐项标注）；AP、HKEX、NVIDIA IR。抓取与更新时间均为Asia/Shanghai。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Global
Iran and Oman discuss a temporary Strait of Hormuz shipping corridor
AP reported on Aug. 25 that the two foreign ministers discussed phased vessel passage, a temporary corridor and joint mine-clearing. A tanker attack off Oman shows energy-security risk remains. The diplomatic window can reduce the oil premium; another attack or failed talks would invalidate that view.
Global
The US widens Iran sanctions as Tehran warns of retaliation
Washington tightened pressure on Iran's economy and energy network, while Tehran said it would not yield and warned sanctions supporters. Conflict and diplomacy are moving together, keeping oil, shipping and inflation expectations volatile; Asian investors should watch both Brent and long Treasury yields.
Tech
Full industry ranking puts uranium and metals on top, specialty retail and chemicals at the bottom
Across all 145 industries on five Moomoo pages, Uranium +4.82%, Pharmaceutical Retailers +3.17%, Aluminum +2.70%, Silver +2.69% and Copper +2.64% led. Confectioners -2.21%, Apparel Manufacturing -2.38%, Footwear -2.72%, Chemicals -3.00% and Specialty Retail -4.25% lagged. Gold and Other Precious Metals both rose 2.18%, positively mapping to A/H gold, copper and rare-earth names.
Tech
Sparks crypto and rare-earth themes rally while lithium batteries and mining lag
Sparks loaded all 118 cards once and returned 109 complete structured concepts. Crypto Mining +6.26%, Crypto Stocks +5.51% and Rare Earths +4.69% led, with GLXY +8.54%, EXOD +23.44% and CRML +21.44%. Lithium Batteries -2.54%, Sports -2.86% and Lithium Mining -3.99% lagged. The A/H test is volume in rare earths versus continued lithium underperformance.
Tech
Semiconductors and storage strengthened in cash trading, but tech proxies softened overnight
Semiconductors rose 1.85% with MRAM +9.23%; the Sparks storage concept gained 2.41% and WDC rose 3.53% in cash trading. At 08:28 CST, however, QQQ was -0.270% and WDC -0.829% overnight, a divergence after a strong close. A/H chips and storage require stronger-than-index auction prices and higher volume for confirmation.
Tech
Nvidia reports tonight, setting up a high-volatility test for the AI chain
Nvidia officially scheduled FY2027 Q2 results for about 16:20 ET on Aug. 26, followed by a 17:00 ET call. NVDA rose 2.19% in cash trading and 0.122% overnight. A/H optical, server and advanced-packaging names should wait for price-volume confirmation; guidance below elevated expectations could amplify losses.
Earnings
WuXi Biologics revenue and EBIT beat expectations; opening feedback remains unverified
Futu's calendar shows first-half revenue of RMB11.787bn, about 2.7% above the RMB11.473bn estimate, and EBIT of RMB3.835bn, about 18.7% above RMB3.231bn. The release came after Hong Kong's close, so no valid price reaction exists yet. A durable gap and volume are needed to confirm the CXO read-through.
Earnings
Nongfu Spring slightly beats revenue expectations as profit keeps double-digit growth
Futu shows first-half revenue of RMB29.718bn, about 0.9% above the RMB29.456bn estimate. Public results report attributable profit of RMB8.887bn, up 16.6% year over year. The release followed the close, so opening price feedback is pending; defensive-consumption strength requires post-gap support.
Earnings
Great Wall Motor beats revenue but slightly misses EBIT, leaving earnings quality under review
Futu shows Q2 revenue of RMB56.992bn, about 3.5% above RMB55.088bn, while EBIT of RMB2.016bn was roughly 0.8% below RMB2.032bn. Hong Kong has not opened, so a revenue beat cannot be treated as a stock-positive outcome; margins, mix and the auction are the key tests.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indices
All three index ETF proxies softened modestly
Futu OpenD at 08:28 CST showed QQQ (Nasdaq-100 proxy) -0.270%, SPY (S&P 500 proxy) -0.125% and DIA (Dow proxy) -0.011%. All were real-time overnight ETF proxies with trades, not index futures. Market time was the Aug. 25 US overnight session, and capture was within 30 minutes of the update.
Sector Check
Industry and concept leaders show confirmation, divergence and potential reversal
Industry Top5 representatives: EU unavailable, HITI unavailable, AA -0.585% divergence, HSLV unavailable and IE +1.595% confirmation. Industry Bottom5: SOWG unavailable, XELB unavailable, FWDI 0.000% divergence, GURE unavailable and ABLV unavailable. Concept Top5: GLXY -0.322% divergence, EXOD 0.000% divergence, CRML +1.604% confirmation, while both GAME rows were unavailable. Concept Bottom5: EQT +0.314% and SLI +0.778% signal potential reversal for weak shale and lithium; RGR and GIL were unavailable. Conclusions use traded names only and never assume cash direction persisted.
A/H Mapping
Resource mapping is firmer than the index signal; chips and lithium await auction confirmation
Gold, silver and copper had strong cash breadth and IE extended gains overnight, supporting A/H resource names. But GLD -0.425% and a negative QQQ argue against chasing precious metals or high-duration tech. SLI's +0.778% is only a counter-signal: lithium mining and batteries must both beat the index in the auction to confirm reversal. A resource gap-fade or deeper QQQ loss invalidates the mapping.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Fact: US cash risk appetite improved, with the S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq up about 0.32%, 0.30% and 0.66%; gold, silver, copper, semiconductors, storage and rare earths strengthened.At runtime, QQQ, SPY and DIA all turned negative overnight, while GLD and WDC fell, showing profit-taking in prior leaders.

View: prioritize independent catalysts in A/H gold, copper, rare earths and WuXi Biologics; follow chips only if the auction beats the index.Although a lithium representative rebounded overnight, the cash concept ranking stayed near the bottom, so treat weakness as unresolved pending reversal confirmation.

Uncertainty: Nvidia earnings, Iran sanctions and Hormuz talks can jointly reset tech valuations and the energy premium. Reduce chasing if northbound/southbound turnover is weak or Hang Seng Tech opens progressively lower.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesGold, silver, copper, rare earths and CXO; cash breadth and local earnings both support them.
Watch ListSemiconductors, storage and AI servers; overnight divergence meets the Nvidia event.
PressureLithium batteries, lithium mining, oil and selected discretionary names; concepts and the oil proxy are weak.
ValidationAuction relative strength, first-30-minute turnover, QQQ/GLD direction and resource gap support.

Logic Chain

US gold, silver, copper, rare earths and semiconductors strengthened in cash trading, supporting A/H resource and tech mapping.
Runtime QQQ, GLD and WDC weakened, showing profit-taking in both tech and precious metals.
The A/H open must confirm independent catalysts in Zijin, Northern Rare Earth, Hua Hong and WuXi Biologics through turnover.
If leaders gap-fade or Hang Seng Tech losses widen, rotate defensive and await Nvidia's results.

Risk Radar

Nvidia Earnings Risk

With elevated expectations, even a modest revenue or guidance miss could hit the AI chain.

Middle East Re-Escalation

Sanctions, retaliation or another strait attack could quickly lift oil and inflation expectations.

Precious-Metals Divergence

Cash industries were strong, but GLD turned lower overnight; chasing is risky.

Lithium Weakness Unresolved

One representative's overnight bounce does not establish a sector reversal.

Earnings Price Feedback Missing

A/H has not opened; WuXi, Nongfu and Great Wall Motor need auction validation.
